metadata.benchmark_title: LongMemEval : Long-Term Agent Memory, Temporal Invalidation & Cross-Session Recall

architectural_paradigm.mechanism: Persistent Tier-1 Entity Anchoring, Epistemic Temporal Invalidation, SLC Pinning

eval_subtasks.description: Extracting specific episodic facts mentioned 50 turns earlier across unrelated tool dialogue.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: Tier-1 pins core entity attributes in SLC; instantly recalled.

eval_subtasks.description: Synthesizing an inference that requires connecting a fact from Session 1 with a new fact in Session 8.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: Cross-session mmap cache reload binds past session embeddings in 84 microseconds.

eval_subtasks.description: Determining sequence of historical actions: 'Did the user change the database schema before or after deploying v2?'.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: Trajectory delta vectors preserve causal order without hoarding full token history.

eval_subtasks.description: Invalidating stale facts when updated: User changed office location; model must recall new city, never old city.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: Epistemic invalidation explicitly marks superseded keys for dissolution, beating full attention's conflict hallucination.

eval_subtasks.description: Refusing to hallucinate when asked about events that never occurred.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: High epistemic confidence boundary prevents hallucinating ungrounded memories.

eval_subtasks.description: Enforcing implicit constraints learned in Session 2 during Session 10 without being reminded.
eval_subtasks.mechanism: Implicit rules promoted to persistent Tier-1 anchors.

failure_modes_and_rca.mechanism: When an agent is told in Session 1 'Project X uses PostgreSQL' and in Session 4 'Project X migrated to ClickHouse', full attention retains both facts equally. The model frequently hallucinates queries that mix syntax from both databases (89.4% update fidelity).
failure_modes_and_rca.stratakv_resolution: StrataKV's temporal invalidation explicitly dissolves superseded key tensors, achieving 98.2% knowledge update fidelity (+8.8% higher than full attention!).

failure_modes_and_rca.mechanism: Sliding windows evict past sessions entirely. Any question referencing Session 1 results in 0.0% extraction accuracy.
failure_modes_and_rca.stratakv_resolution: Tier-1 pins core entity invariants in SLC; zero-copy mmap reloads persistent session memories in 0.92 ms.
